name: cua
description: Computer use for Claude Code on macOS (Apple silicon) and Linux (X11) through OpenAI's computer-use runtime: a stdio MCP server running the pinned runtime that `cua install` places under CUA_HOME, whose devices_list and devices_use tools switch it to a remote device added with `cua devices` (a cua agent behind a relay) and back; an Elicitation hook that accepts cua_repl's app and site approvals, so none shows a dialog; the cua-remote skill, to set up a device or connect to one; and, as function hooks (under CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1), /secret KEY, a secret stored in ~/.config/claude-secrets that the model sees only by its key, and devcloud's secrets guard, which redacts and never refuses: stored values, credential-file values and token-shaped strings become handles in what the model reads, and handles restore to their exact bytes on write; it stands down when devcloud's own plugin is loaded.
